Frequently asked questions

Are these PDF tools really free?

Yes. Every PDF tool on DoraPDF is free, with no sign-up, no daily limit and no watermark on your files.

Are my PDF files uploaded?

No. The tools run in your browser, so your PDFs are processed on your own phone or computer and never sent to a server.

Which PDF tool should I use to make a file smaller?

Use Compress PDF. If the PDF is mostly photos or scans, it can usually shrink a lot while staying readable.
